coverage_note: Covers the UA intervention (also omics exposure), calcium chelation, and targeted genetic/pharmacologic perturbations validating omics-nominated nodes in C. elegans and mammalian cells. RNAi and mutant of one gene, epistatic combinations, and multiple readouts are child contrasts. Descriptive omics, external and future-work items are boundaries.

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: A genetic perturbation with aging-relevant organelle outcome, but it is a premise experiment that neither uses nor validates an omics-generated candidate, so it sits outside the integrated multi-omics workflow. A stricter reviewer might admit it under mechanistic support.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: RNAi of pink-1/pdr-1/dct-1 phenocopying age-related organelle defects

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: PQ (toxicant positive control) and NMN (distinct-pathway comparator) are interventions but are used only to contrast UA's mechanism, not to validate the report's UA aging link.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Paraquat and NMN comparator treatments for calcium/mitophagy specificity

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential expression and enrichment discovery layer. It generates candidates but is descriptive (no effect-identification design of its own); the causal contrasts are the downstream perturbations.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: UA-versus-control worm transcriptomic/proteomic DEG, GO and GSVA analysis

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Undirected functional-interconnectivity network with no directed causal method; excluded per the network-centrality exclusion.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Proteomic network analysis of UA-altered proteins

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: A null differential-modification readout of DRP-1 under the UA intervention; it is a molecular readout within the UA worm design rather than a separate causal analysis.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: DRP-1::GFP immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry for UA-induced PTMs (null)

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential gene expression and GO enrichment on a re-analyzed external dataset, used to argue conservation; descriptive rather than an effect-identification design.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Re-analysis of public HT29 UA transcriptome (DEG/GO)

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Stated in the discussion citing prior work (ref 19); no current-report empirical result for this contrast.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: PINK-1 requirement for UA lifespan extension

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Cited external finding discussed for context; the report explicitly states whether it acts like UA needs to be examined, so no current-report result.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Kaempferol modulation of MCU calcium uptake

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Explicitly proposed future work with no current-report result.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Proposed future studies on calcium signaling, organelle contacts and mitophagy enhancers

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Urolithin A supplementation in C. elegans (omics exposure and geroprotection)
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Caenorhabditis elegans whole organism, with intestinal, body-wall muscle and neuronal organelle/calcium/mitophagy reporters
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Central controlled intervention and the exposure arm of the multi-omics comparison. Many molecular readouts (MAMs, membrane potential, DRP-1 imaging) are child contrasts of this one UA-versus-control design and are not split out.
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Controlled dietary supplementation of urolithin A (50 uM on NGM) versus untreated/vehicle plates; UA is also the exposure arm of the paired transcriptome and proteome comparison

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: EGTA calcium chelation necessity test for UA effects in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Caenorhabditis elegans whole organism, muscle and neuronal reporters
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Distinct perturbed target (calcium) from the UA intervention, testing necessity of calcium for the omics-highlighted mechanism. Kept separate from UA because the exposure and comparator change.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: UA-treated worms without EGTA (and untreated controls)
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Pharmacologic calcium chelation with EGTA (10 mM) co-administered with UA, versus UA alone

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: ITR-1/ITPR/InsP3R loss of function (omics candidate) in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Caenorhabditis elegans whole organism, muscle reporters
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Clear omics-candidate-followed-by-perturbation: itr-1 was a transcriptomic hit confirmed by qRT-PCR, then genetically depleted. RNAi and mutant of the same target counted as one analysis.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Control RNAi / wild-type with matched UA and untreated conditions
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: Depletion of ITR-1/ITPR/InsP3R ER calcium-release channel
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: RNAi knockdown and itr-1(sa73) loss-of-function mutant of an omics-nominated transcript (itr-1 upregulated and qRT-PCR validated), tested with UA

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: TMCO-1 and EMC-3 ER calcium-release channel depletion (proteomic candidates) in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Two proteome-nominated ER channel genes tested jointly with identical outcomes and no separate contrast detail, so grouped as one design unit representing the ER calcium-release machinery.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Control RNAi / wild-type with matched UA and untreated conditions
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: Depletion of TMCO-1/EMC-3 ER calcium-release machinery
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: RNAi knockdown of tmco-1 and emc-3, ER-morphology proteins elevated in the UA proteome, tested with UA

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: MCU-1/MCU loss of function in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Caenorhabditis elegans whole organism, muscle reporters
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Validates the omics-nominated calcium-transport mechanism (pathway-level candidate). Distinct perturbed target from itr-1, so a separate unit; epistatic double perturbations are treated as child contrasts.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Control RNAi / wild-type with matched UA and untreated conditions
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: Depletion of MCU-1/MCU mitochondrial calcium uniporter
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: RNAi knockdown and mcu-1(ju1154) mutant of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter, tested with UA

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: DRP-1/DNM1L/DRP1 loss of function in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Caenorhabditis elegans whole organism, muscle and neuronal reporters
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Validates the fission node of the omics-highlighted mitophagy mechanism; DRP-1 was also probed by IP proteomics. Mammalian Mdivi-1 phenocopy serves as orthogonal validation of the same link.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Control RNAi / wild-type with matched UA and untreated conditions
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: RNAi knockdown and drp-1(tm1108) mutant of the fission GTPase, tested with UA and EGTA

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: SKN-1/NFE2L2/Nrf2 loss of function in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: SKN-1 necessity for UA lifespan is a current-report result (Figure S5A) even though also reported previously; validates the omics biogenesis module. UA-induced SKN-1 activation supports the same link.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Control RNAi / wild-type with matched UA and untreated conditions
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: RNAi knockdown of skn-1, tested with UA for lifespan

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: UNC-43/CAMK2D loss of function in C. elegans
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Caenorhabditis elegans whole organism, muscle and neuronal reporters
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Perturbation of the calcium-to-biogenesis node identified through the omics-enriched mitochondrial-biogenesis and calcium modules. Distinct target, separate unit.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Control RNAi / wild-type with matched UA and untreated conditions
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: RNAi knockdown and unc-43(tm1605) mutant of the calcium/calmodulin kinase, tested with UA

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Urolithin A treatment in normal mammalian cells (conserved-mechanism validation, incl. senescence)
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Normal human BJ fibroblasts and HUVEC (also MEF, HMC3 microglia)
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Distinct biological system from the worm work, validating the conserved UA-calcium-mitophagy-antisenescence link the multi-omics analysis proposed. Cell types are child contrasts of one UA intervention; senescence is included as an outcome.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Vehicle-treated cells (and H2O2 without UA for senescence)
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Controlled UA treatment versus vehicle in normal human/mouse cell lines, with H2O2 stress-induced premature senescence model for the senescence contrast

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: EGTA calcium chelation necessity test in mammalian cells
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Normal human BJ fibroblasts and HUVEC
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Distinct calcium-chelation perturbation in mammalian cells, separate from worm EGTA by biological system. Worm EGTA result provides orthogonal support for the same calcium-dependency link.
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Pharmacologic calcium chelation with EGTA co-administered with UA in human cells, versus UA alone

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Thapsigargin ER calcium-store depletion in mammalian cells
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Normal human BJ fibroblasts and HUVEC
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Distinct perturbed target (SERCA/ER calcium stores) establishing that targeted ER-to-mitochondria transfer, not general cytosolic calcium, is needed. Separate from EGTA and Mdivi-1 by target.
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: ER calcium-store depletion via SERCA inhibition
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Pharmacologic ATP2A/SERCA inhibition with thapsigargin depleting ER calcium stores, co-treated with UA

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Mdivi-1 DRP1 inhibition in mammalian cells
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Normal human BJ fibroblasts and HUVEC
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Distinct DRP1-inhibition perturbation in mammalian cells that phenocopies the worm drp-1 knockdown, validating the conserved fission node. Worm data cited as orthogonal support.
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Pharmacologic DNM1L/DRP1 inhibition with Mdivi-1, co-treated with UA
